issue.title: Add a Cancel Log term to the glossary
issue.description:
The Cancel task picker (epic bob-cli-2w) now writes a managed Cancel Log, and bob-cli docs plus the README glossary row describe it. The glossary web still has Schedule Log and Work Log only. `sase memory read glossary:cancel-log` fails as an unknown strand.

Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-2w.4 (note: "PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: add glossary:cancel-log term for the managed Cancel Log"). This is outside the epic: the approved plan told that phase to propose the term and not edit sase/memory/.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add a new glossary strand at glossary/cancel-log.md (keyword Cancel Log, slug cancel-log), in the same short voice as glossary:work-log. Describe the managed first-child `❌ **CANCEL LOG**` written by the Ctrl+Shift+P Cancel row: newest-first `*YYYY-MM-DD* — <reason>` entries; an empty reason writes no log unless one already exists, in which case the entry is `🤷 no reason given`; project conversion carries the log. Do not edit the strand until Bryan authorizes the memory change.

issue.creation_reason: Phase bob-cli-2w.4 proposed a glossary:cancel-log strand and left it unwritten because memory edits need Bryan's authorization.
